name: vx3-dedicated-first-hop-switch-d1-d4-20270429-20270505
qualityPolicyNotes: Vx-3 closure slice A (serial 49): replace the transitional --enable-preclass-actions gate with a dedicated --enable-preclass-first-hop switch. This requires making opts.c and client_meta.c compilable under the local mandatory clang gate via real cross-platform conditional compilation (POSIX getopt/unistd kept for Linux/macOS; a minimal in-source getopt shim and _isatty/_fileno mapping for _WIN32/__MINGW32__, mirroring the existing strings.h->strcasecmp _stricmp pattern), then declaring/mapping/parsing the new switch with default off and its meta.c usage line, and finally switching the client_flow first-hop gate from preclass_action_enable to preclass_first_hop_enable. --disable-address-preclass remains the full rollback; stdout/stderr contract unchanged. Per user direction, project documentation edits (USAGE_CN/EN, rules RFC, RELEASE_NOTES) are handled separately outside this A/B task definition.
